registeredBeforeResults: When this file was committed no A04 hypothesis had been computed on the validation or holdout split. The rule below was chosen on train only, in the exploration round (runs/explore/alarms-20261109-1621.md, ledger trials 320..436, ledger total 599 at registration), after the IP-T474 forming-filter fix. The holdout is locked and has never been opened.
approvedBy: user, 2026-11-09 ("Amendment 04: register the detection alarm as a finalist")
question: Does a within-morning rank alarm recognize a forming gapper earlier and more often than the screen a trader already has (top gainers with fresh news first), at the same false-alarm rate, on data it never saw?
population: Amendment 01's population: candidate days (weight 1) and population-sample days (weight 1/rate). A morning is scorable when it has a reach20By0945 label and is still below +20% (bar highs) at 06:00 ET.
label: reach20By0945, with the first +20% touch time taken from bar highs of bars ending by 09:45 ET, as the labeler defines it.
sweep: Every scorable morning is swept minute by minute 06:00-09:10 ET using only bars ending at or before each minute (OnsetTrack). A rule's alarm is the first minute in that window at which the rule passes; at most one alarm per morning per rule.

R4.name: rank composite top5, gap [5%,15%), $50k, conf>=0.5
R4.score: composite(t) = mean of the finite values among three weighted cross-sectional percentile ranks over that morning's population rows at minute t: volRatioTod(t), pmRet(t) (gap of the last close over the prior close), and the one-sided volume CUSUM statistic with drift ln 2 against the frozen train time-of-day volume profile (z capped at ln 20, volume pseudocount ADV20 x 1e-5). A population-sample row weighs 1/rate (10).
R4.pass: the row is among the 5 highest composite scores among the morning's rows not yet alarmed with pmRet(t) < 15% (weighted count of higher-ranked eligible rows < 5), and pmRet(t) >= 5%, and cumulative premarket dollar volume to t >= $50,000, and conf(t) = pmVwapRet / pmRet >= 0.5.
R4.fitted: No parameter is fitted on the split under test; the time-of-day volume profile is the frozen train profile (data/tod-profile.json).

B4.name: B3 gainers+news top10, gap [2%,15%), $50k
B4.score: gainers+news(t) = 1e6 if a news item or 8-K with pubToT <= 60 minutes exists at t, else 0, plus pmRet(t).
B4.pass: among the 10 highest gainers+news scores among the morning's rows not yet alarmed with pmRet(t) < 15%, and pmRet(t) >= 2%, and cumulative premarket dollar volume to t >= $50,000.
B4.why: On train this benchmark had the same false-alarm rate as R4 (0.83 per 100 mornings), so the comparison is made at matched false alarms.

metrics.hitRate: weighted share of scorable mornings that reach +20% by 09:45 whose alarm came before the first +20% touch
metrics.faPer100: weighted alarms on scorable mornings that do not reach +20% by 09:45, per 100 weighted scorable mornings
metrics.lead: minutes from the alarm to the first +20% touch on hits

hypotheses.claim: The R4 alarm catches more future +20% movers than the gainers+news benchmark B4 at no more false alarms: hitRate(R4) - hitRate(B4) >= 0.03 and faPer100(R4) - faPer100(B4) <= 0.10.
hypotheses.method: Both rules on the same scorable mornings. The hit-rate difference and the false-alarm difference are bootstrapped over whole days with weights kept (params.statistics.bootstrapDraws, seed, ciLevel). Supported when the hit-rate difference is >= 0.03 with its lower bound > 0 and the false-alarm difference's point estimate is <= 0.10; refuted when the hit-rate difference's upper bound is < 0.03 or the false-alarm difference's lower bound is > 0.10; undecided otherwise.

hypotheses.claim: R4's alarms come well before the move: the median lead from alarm to the first +20% touch on hits is at least 30 minutes.
hypotheses.method: Weighted median lead over R4 hits with a day-clustered bootstrap 95% interval; descriptive (F3, interval only). Supported when the interval lies at or above 30; refuted when it lies below 30.

decisionRules.corrections: A04 runs are corrected as their own set (Holm on H25, the only primary). Frozen and A01-A03 corrections are unchanged.
decisionRules.trainRun: The train run only checks that the confirmatory code reproduces the exploration numbers; it carries no verdict weight.
decisionRules.promotion: A04 tests detection only. A supported H25 on validation and on the holdout makes R4 the watchlist and alarm for the live formation recorder (paper, alerts only). It cannot place, size or exit a trade: every long trading rule tested so far lost money after costs (H12, H12p, H18, explore entries and exit routes), and no trading rule is registered here.
decisionRules.killCriterion: A04 neither triggers nor lifts the H11/H11p kill criterion.
decisionRules.holdout: The single holdout test invocation runs frozen and A01-A04 hypotheses together; it requires the user's explicit go-ahead.
decisionRules.reporting: Every A04 result is reported, failures included, with both rules' hit rate, false alarms per 100 mornings, alarms per day and lead side by side.
decisionRules.notRegistered: The fade-short candidate seen in the exploration (Tier50+ gappers extending < 10% from the open at 09:45) is not part of A04; it would need its own amendment with an exact entry, exit, borrow and margin model.
